Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 11:12:00 -0400
Subject: ACE registration + Ops accelerator inquiry

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're evaluating Redwood to power an inference layer for our Ops Accelerator product and want to explore the AWS ACE/co-sell route — particularly: 1) timeline for ACE registration, 2) what PDM/PSM pairing looks like, and 3) any marketplace listing prerequisites (billing/contract/entitlement flow).

Can we get a quick checklist and a draft mutual action plan? We have an internal procurement window in mid-August that would be ideal if the ACE process can be initiated this week.

Attaching a one-pager with the product scope.

Thanks,
John

jdavies@acme.com

Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACE registration + Ops accelerator inquiry

John — great to meet you over email. Short answer: yes, we can move on ACE this week. High-level next steps below and I copied Aditya (partner lead) and Karthik (solutions) to scope ops+procurement items.

Quick starter checklist (can convert to MAP):
- Internal ACE eligibility review (Redwood -> AWS intake) — aditya to submit.
- PDM/PSM intro & alignment call (schedule 30–45m).
- Marketplace listing requirements: commercial contact, billing entity, logos, marketing blurb, and a supported AMI/container build (we can provide a checklist).
- Procurement redlines: addendum & SOW (we'll share template SOW-draft-v2.pdf).
- Mutual action plan with milestones (ACE submission, PDM intro, marketplace artifact submission, listing cert).

Can you confirm the billing entity (legal name + billing address) and preferred PO cadence? If you can share that, we'll draft the MAP and kick the ACE registration.

I'll put a tentative calendar invite for a PDM/PSM intro on Wednesday morning PT unless you prefer a different time.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

Attachments: SOW-draft-v2.pdf (application/pdf); ACE_quick-checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, John Davies <jdavies@acme.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACE registration + Ops accelerator inquiry

Thanks all — quick note with scheduling + action items after reviewing ACME one-pager.

Irene, can you loop in the ACE rep (AWS) so we can confirm regional eligibility? John, cc'd here is Lauren from our legal/commerce team to assist on billing entity and PO terms. Karthik — we'll need a short tech brief (1–2 pages) that calls out: expected qps, typical sequence lengths, and any data residency constraints so PDM/PSM can size the co-sell offering and match a PSM.

Proposed immediate actions (Aditya):
- I will start the ACE intake form today and mark ACME as an accelerated submission (we have a partner motion template).
- Lauren, can you confirm if ACME's preferred invoicing (net-30 vs net-45) has any compliance blockers?
- Karthik, target: brief due EOD Thu so we can attach to ACE intake (this helps PDM prioritization).

John — could you send billing entity details and a sample supplier W9 (or equivalent). If procurement prefers a Master Subscription Agreement cadence, share that too.

Thanks,
Aditya
Sr. Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

Next steps agreed on the call:
- Aditya to file ACE intake and share tracking link (ETA: today).
- Karthik to deliver 1–2 page tech brief (ETA: EOD today).
- Lauren to confirm redline process and share the SOW template with procurement.
- John and Maya will prep an internal co-sell slideset for their leadership (we'll share with PDM/PSM).

If ACE rep can confirm target PDM and PSM assignments, we can lock dates for the canary listing and co-sell kickoff.

Best,
John
